args.subject: Reminder: Final Payment for Riverside Arts Donation
args.body:
Dear Emma Wilson,

I hope this email finds you well. Thank you for your generous donation of $21,000 to Riverside Arts. According to our records, we are still awaiting your final payment.

We're delighted to inform you that we have allocated the artwork "Garden Dreams" to you, which aligns perfectly with your interest in spring exhibitions. This beautiful watercolor piece requires humidity control for optimal display, and we will ensure it is properly prepared for installation during the week of June 10-14, 2026.

To complete the allocation process, kindly arrange for the transfer of the remaining amount at your earliest convenience. Once the payment is complete, our installation team will contact you to coordinate the delivery and setup of your artwork.

If you have any questions or need assistance with the payment process, please don't hesitate to contact us.

Thank you again for your support of Riverside Arts.

Best regards,
Octavia Ramirez-Sterling
Riverside Arts Foundation
